compliance.summary: The verdict is BOUNDARY because while no hard limits were violated (region_distance=0.0), the system operated across the full spectrum of allowed lighting conditions ('bright', 'moderate', 'dim'), exhausting the categorical margin for this axis. The closest numeric parameter to its ODD limit was max_pitch_deg, which reached 12.33° against a 15° specification, but this remained within its safety margin and was attributed to a simulation artifact.

report.executive_summary: The robot operated safely within a simulated indoor environment, successfully navigating without any collisions or prohibited actor detections. The system reached the edge of its operational design domain by experiencing the full range of permissible lighting, from well-lit to dim. Although the robot's body tilt also neared its stability limit, this was identified as a simulation-specific anomaly and does not indicate a risk in real-world conditions.

key_findings.perception: The robot navigated a simulated indoor commercial space with hardwood and tile floors. Obstacle density was consistently low, peaking at only 3.2%. Lighting conditions varied significantly, covering the entire allowed range from 'bright' to 'dim', which was the primary driver of the boundary verdict.
key_findings.motion: Robot dynamics were well-controlled, with a maximum speed of 0.28 m/s, far below the 1.5 m/s limit. A peak pitch of 12.33° was recorded, consuming 82% of the 15° ODD allowance, though this was flagged as a simulation artifact.
key_findings.safety: No humans or animals were detected, and the system experienced no collisions. The 'lighting_conditions' axis operated with zero remaining margin by using all its allowed categories. The 'max_pitch_deg' axis had the smallest numeric margin at 17.8%.
key_findings.temporal_trends: The system's performance was stable throughout the scenario. A temporary perception issue occurred in window w007, where a poor camera view led to a 'dim' lighting assessment and required reliance on LiDAR data. This event coincided with the observed peak in robot pitch.

terrain_type.description: Ground surface type. Assess from camera view of floor. List specific materials visible. High-pile carpet or outdoor surfaces are OUT OF ODD.

obstacle_density.description: Fraction of BEV area occupied by obstacles (0-1). Computed from BEV occupancy map, not camera. Handles moderate to high furniture density up to 0.8.

clearance_index.description: Navigability of the path ahead (0-1). 1=clear path. 0=fully blocked. Paths must remain reasonably clear for navigation. Computed from BEV. Min set to 0.3 for indoor spaces.

animal_present.description: Binary animal detection. 1=animal visible anywhere in camera frame (OUT OF ODD - halt required). 0=no animals detected (IN ODD). Assess from CAMERA only, not BEV. Any animal visible = violation.
